title: Pitfalls of Topology-Aware Image Segmentation
mechanism: Shows that the connectivity choice, topological artefacts in the ground truth and metric misuse change the rankings of topology methods, and gives recommendations.
adaptation: Benchmark rules: fix 8-connectivity for crack components, audit tiny label fragments, report Betti / component metrics only next to overlap and relF1@2.
min_experiment: No training. Recompute component metrics for existing PF predictions under 4- and 8-connectivity, with and without fragments < 20 px. Check whether method rankings flip.
evidence: R (abstract): the three pitfalls measurably change evaluation and ranking.

alt_notes.adaptation: Benchmark design: fix 8-connectivity for crack components, audit tiny label fragments, report Betti / component metrics only together with IoU and relF1@2.
alt_notes.min_experiment: No training: recompute component and Betti metrics for the existing 5-seed PF ensemble under 4- and 8-connectivity and with / without sub-20 px label fragments; if rankings of existing arms change, adopt the stricter protocol.

alt_notes.adaptation: Benchmark protocol: fix 8-connectivity for component metrics, report components found on cleaned GT, avoid Betti metrics on 1-2 px jittered crack labels, report tolerant metrics.
alt_notes.min_experiment: No training. Re-score saved house/PF predictions under 4- vs 8-connectivity and with/without GT cleaning; kill the extra metric if rankings do not change.
